summary: community.docker deprecated the default ignore value of docker_container's image_name_mismatch, which changes to recreate in 4.0.0; a warning shows when the change would matter.
questions: docker_container warns about image_name_mismatch, what should I set?
Will docker_container recreate containers when the image name changes?

answer_card.title: docker_container image_name_mismatch default
answer_card.answer_md:
The default **`image_name_mismatch: ignore`** of `docker_container` changes to **`recreate`** in community.docker **4.0.0**. Set it explicitly to keep current behaviour and silence the warning:

```yaml
image_name_mismatch: ignore
```
